title: Memory note v0
description: A durable, searchable fact in long-term memory. Notes are the compact layer; the journal (memory/journal-entry) is the complete layer and is never deleted. Every note points back to the journal entries and evidence it came from, so a compressed note can always be checked against the original.

scope.description: agent: private to the owner (independent agent memory). project: readable by agents with shared_read.

kind.description: fact: something true about the system. decision: something decided and why. observation: something seen during work. todo: an open question or follow-up. summary: a compression of other notes/journal entries. claim: written by the system for a claim submitted during a task; it is exactly as true as that claim's CURRENT status, which recall reads live (docs/adr/0006).

sources.description: Journal entry ids (jrn_...) and/or note ids (mem_...) this note was derived from.
